The '''[[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]''' of the [[Charon/Legends|Charon]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was located in [[otherspace]]. It was located near a massive [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]].<ref name="Otherspace" />

The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was the first to fall victim to the [[Charon Death Cult]], who cleansed the world of all non-believers before turning their attention to the rest of otherspace.<ref name="Otherspace" />
